FOUR ALTERNATIVES. FOUR DIFFERENT REASONS.

Tipo alternatives.
Your next team needs a different checklist.

Tipo has a clear service and staff ladder: the free plan lists one of each, Basic lists ten, and Pro lists unlimited services and team members. Alternatives become relevant when growth means more than headcount, such as deposits, packages, locations or an external marketing workflow.

What would make switching worthwhile?

Tipo’s service and staff tiers can be straightforward to budget. If they fit your team, verify any missing workflow with support before taking on migration work.

YOUR DECISION STARTS HERE

The differences that matter for Tipo users.

01

Ten providers or more

Tipo Basic is $9.90/month for ten services/team members; Pro is $14.90 for unlimited services and team members. Compare the required tier at your team size.

02

Calendar and date-range booking

Basic lists Google Calendar and multiday booking. A replacement should retain both if you use them.

03

More involved payment and loyalty offers

Verify deposits, booking packs and Klaviyo separately. General flexible-payment language does not prove a particular deposit or subscription workflow.

Cowlendar

Test groups, rentals and payment options with the same feature set and revenue-based pricing.

YOUR MIGRATION CHECKLIST

Test the reason you are switching.

  1. Count services as well as staff Record how the existing menu maps to providers. Check whether the new app models a location or resource separately.
  2. Test each required payment flow Recreate a deposit, remaining-balance collection and cancellation using the service you actually sell.
  3. Preserve the team’s schedule Verify availability, calendar connections and upcoming appointments for each provider before launch.

Tipo alternatives: common questions.

When does Tipo need the Pro plan?

The current listing describes Basic with ten services/team members and Pro with unlimited services and team members. Check any other required features at the same time.

Which alternatives suit a more complex service mix?

Cowlendar is relevant for appointments, rentals, bundles and subscriptions together. BookX is worth evaluating for explicit location/staff tiers, while Apntly offers a low-cost appointment route.
